tree.heading: Initiative
tree.text: The term “Initiative” means the National Engineering Biology Research and Development Initiative established under section 19132 of this title.

tree.heading: Omics
tree.text: The term “omics” refers to the collective technologies used to explore the roles, relationships, and actions of the various types of molecules that make up the cells and systems of an organism and the systems level analysis of their functions.

notes.heading: Executive Order No. 14081
notes.text: Ex. Ord. No. 14081, Sept. 12, 2022, 87 F.R. 56849, which related to advancing biotechnology and biomanufacturing innovation for a sustainable, safe, and secure American bioeconomy, was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 14236, § 2(k), Mar. 14, 2024, 90 F.R. 13037.
